biography:
With over 15 years of experience in the energy and sustainability sector, I lead the Americas energy procurement team at Amazon Web Services (AWS), powering the cloud with low cost carbon free energy. 

I am passionate about creating and implementing innovative solutions that reduce carbon emissions, increase energy efficiency, and enhance business performance. As a certified Project Management Professional (PMP) and LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP), I manage complex programs, collaborate with diverse stakeholders, and deliver results that align with the company's vision and goals. 

Previously, I led Amazon's consumer renewable energy team, where I built developer relationships and scaled commercial structures to achieve 100% renewable energy by 2025. I also led the energy, water and renewables strategy for 9,500 Starbucks stores in the US and Canada, where I developed a $140 MM renewable energy portfolio, directed a $60 MM/yr deregulated electricity procurement program, and optimized building systems. 

I love learning and sharing best practices to contribute to advancing the renewable energy industry.
